This charming scene contains a message. The children of a fisherman, with their tattered rags and paltry toys, offer us a glimpse of their future.

Waiting for the catch was a daily event on the beach at Scheveningen. Everyone in the village, young and old, came out to pilot the boats to shore, to haul them up onto the beach by horse, and to snap up the freshly caught fish.
